answer: A bond of 41% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in pearl, and orchard reconciles the forfeits at each close. A 241 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
